title: fix(compile): shape colorEffect lost on initial placement (isFirst path)
description: In compile.ts, the isFirst (initial placement) branch for shapes checks only `displayObj.alpha` and not `displayObj.colorEffect`. A shape with a tint, brightness, or advanced color effect set on frame 1 gets placed with a plain PlaceObject2 (no CXForm), silently discarding the color effect. Subsequent-frame updates correctly check `colorEffect` first and emit CXFormWithAlpha. The fix is to mirror the shape's subsequent-frame logic in the isFirst branch: check `colorEffect` first (emit tinted CXForm), then fall through to the standalone alpha and visible checks. The text branch already handles this correctly (lines ~1807–1815 of compile.ts).
